scope: RCL-owned bounded three-replica grow-counter join with safe-integer components, stale/reordered/duplicate delivery, partitions/healing, invalid sender rejection and source-owned monotone commit; actual HTTP packet replay with isolated target instances; no cryptographic member identity, cross-host deployment or arbitrary distributed-system claim; actual monotonic timer release and asynchronous native RCL process with source-owned sampled-deadline publication, cancellation/exit observation and failure settlement; local soft realtime, no hard OS interrupt/timing guarantee or external effects

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual monotonic timers and asynchronous native process exit
RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery
authorityProfile: RCL conditional warrants own local sampled-deadline publication; Node transports clock observations, stops owned processes and waits for real exit; no hard realtime/OS interruption guarantee

trials.intent: Join grow-counter snapshots by the maximum of each component, so duplicates and stale delivery never decrease a component and do not count increments twice.
Only replica identifiers zero, one and two belong to this group; reject every other sender before merging its counter components.
The commit_replicas transition requires the replicator subject to hold replica.merge on replicas; retain the conditional current-input admission boundary.
